full_page.content:
Page 91 Cont.
Aug. 17 Mrs. M. McIlvenna - 58 - breast cancer fears operation - ask for prayers to get well without Operation.
18 Thom Ulach - 4 - from cleveland - here To-day has never spoken seem- ingly understands ... Enrolled 5.
18 Mary Povileitis - 12 - Curviture of spine ....
Mrs. Anna Rosmala - 27 - operated on for bleeding tuomer - has had ten transfusions - Enrolled To-day 5.
Page 92
Aug. 18 Robert Mckinley - 13 - lutheran - Very slow in learning - hard to get a school to take him - like mongolian.
19th Patrick McMahan - 5 - atack of acute appendicitis this p.m. - car- ried in to monastery office at 6:50 on way to St. Mary's Hospital and inscribed in Ser. Masses. 1. - Promising perpetual and more frequent Communion.
Carol Ann Charles - 22 months - Episcopelian - operation on spine six months ago - now feet are not growing as they should.
Bonnie Sue Drolshagen - 2 - hopeless
21 Albert Meress - 36 - Ex polio got his back broken 6-7 yrs. ago; has had untold trouble since .... and continual headaches - Enrolles per- petually and promises frequent Communion.
Wm. J. Judge - 58 - had stroke March 3rd 1940. Drs gave very little hope of him ever walking properly again or of using left arm. His daughter brought him to these services several Wednesdays - - Was quite over this stroke a year later; now has something like cancer.
Page 93 Aug. 22 Maareen Naiditch - 15 - Infantile paralysis late last month in H. Kiefer's - stopped breathing for 20 minutes and nor for about a month has be breathing artificially. Enrolled in Ser. Masses three weeks ago (Aug. 3) and is very slowly improving. There is hope now of a possible recovery. Family ... promise more frequent communions ..... her classmates enroll her perpetually.
